review_evidence: The primary inventory is overwhelmingly UniMath/*.v formal source, spanning foundations, algebra, category theory, homological algebra, topology and related mathematics.

Files with tutorial, test or example roles remain formal Coq material; e.g. Algebra/GaussianElimination/Tests.v and documentation/guides/tutorials/*.v are not excluded by role name under the repository policy.
Repository Makefiles, metadata and other non-formal support files are already outside the primary formal-source surface, so no additional source-local hard exclusion is established.
summary: Reviewed the UniMath Coq source snapshot; retain all 1,645 primary formal files as a large univalent-foundations and mathematics corpus.
